name: login
description: log in — auto-skips if the saved session is still valid

name: goto
description: navigate

name: mode
description: nav style for navmenu (human=click through, quick=jump via @id)

name: navmenu
description: navigate by clicking menu labels (human) or #action=id (quick); @xmlid reads the labels in the user's language

name: click
description: standard Playwright click (waits for visibility)

name: fclick
description: force click (bypasses visibility checks)

name: jclick
description: JS .click() (OWL2-friendly for Odoo SPA buttons)

name: clickbtn
description: click button by visible label (prints internal name)

name: clickrpc
description: like clickbtn but FAILS unless a call_button/call_kw RPC fires

name: buttons
description: list visible buttons: internal name + label

name: field
description: edit an Odoo field in the active dialog/form and verify it

name: rowset
description: edit an existing row (#1 or field=exact text)

name: fill
description: fill input (use single quotes for selectors with spaces)

name: date
description: set a date/datetime field WITHOUT clicking (no 30s picker hang); ISO 2026-06-01[ 18:00] is converted to the user's format

name: type
description: type text into focused element (keyboard events, no selector)

name: m2o
description: many2one: click cell → clear → type → pick the MATCHING result

name: pick
description: pick an OPEN autocomplete option by text (skips Create/Search More; OWL+v14)

name: celltype
description: v14 editable-list: JS-click cell → focus its input → type

name: boolcell
description: editable-list checkbox: activate row, toggle, verify it flipped

name: scroll
description: scrollIntoView, no click/focus (Odoo scrolls inside .o_content)

name: record
description: open a record form directly by model + id (no menu needed)

name: breadcrumb
description: click a breadcrumb by index (default: parent level)

name: cols
description: print a table's header cells with column index (order varies per table)

name: addline
description: add row to One2many list, waits for new row to appear

name: press
description: keyboard press (Enter, Tab, Escape, ArrowDown...)

name: wait
description: pause (fixed — prefer waitidle/waitfor)

name: waitidle
description: wait until Odoo is idle (network + loading overlay), fast

name: timeout
description: set per-action fail-fast timeout (default 8000)

name: strict
description: abort the whole flow on first error/timeout (default off)

name: screenshot
description: save screenshot to traces/ (default full page)

name: step
description: start a user-manual section; when the next step starts or the flow ends, a 1440x900 screenshot is saved and marks are cleared

name: capture
description: record a value (e.g. document number, record id) for {{name}} and result.json

name: snapshot
description: print page element tree (for selector discovery)

name: eval
description: evaluate a JS EXPRESSION and print the result. It is wrapped in a plain function, so top-level await is a syntax error — write `eval odoo.__WOWL_DEBUG__.root.actionService.doAction(...)` (a returned promise is awaited for you) or an async IIFE, not `eval await ...`

name: cookie
description: set a raw browser cookie (works for HttpOnly, e.g. session_id)

name: highlight
description: draw Playwright's native pink box (screenshot-only, invisible in trace viewer)

name: mark
description: inject a REAL red box+caption around an element (visible in trace viewer Snapshot tab)

name: unmark
description: remove all marks added by `mark`

name: bbox
description: print an element's {x,y,width,height} viewport box (for custom annotation)

name: evals
description: print outerHTML of matched elements (structure inspection)

name: find
description: print matching elements (max 5)

name: waitfor
description: wait for selector to appear

name: url
description: print current URL

name: title
description: print page title

name: expect
description: assert a UI outcome; `expect state` accepts the label or the internal key (e.g. sale)

name: done
description: stop trace, save zip, exit
